analysis_set.span: There were 532 patients who were excluded from the analysis (486 patients subsequently refused to provide consent and 46 were duplicate patients [the first enrollment for those patients was kept in the analysis]), leaving 10 520 patients for the analysis

follow_up.span: A follow-up contact was performed (centrally at the HCor Research Institute) by telephone at 90 days after enrollment to assess vital status and need for kidney replacement therapy after discharge.

entry_age.span: ELIGIBILITY AGE/SEX: minimum age 18 Years | maximum age None | sex ALL

notes: The analysis excluded patients after randomization; an unqualified all-randomized ITT label is not supported. For the primary outcome, 15 patients were censored at hospital discharge and 10 had outcomes imputed, so this was not solely a complete-case analysis. Age eligibility is established by the registry. The full-text Patients section and registry eligibility criteria identify no population outside the question's critically ill adults. The served estimate is an adjusted HR, not the requested RR.
